# Code & Math Notes

This section is designed for short technical notes, reproducible examples, and explanations of mathematical and statistical ideas.

## Example: a reproducible R calculation

```{r}
#| label: demo-r
#| echo: true
#| output: true

set.seed(8670)
x <- rnorm(1000)
c(mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x))
```

## Topics I plan to publish

- Statistical computing in R
- Numerical optimization algorithms
- Bayesian simulation and MCMC
- Survival-analysis examples
- Regularization and high-dimensional regression
- Pattern recognition and machine learning
- Mathematical derivations with reproducible code
